_comment: Curated industry-term -> KSIC code aliases (10th revision, Statistics Korea). Common business terms rarely appear in official KSIC names (e.g. '조선' vs '선박 및 보트 건조업'). Every code MUST exist in ksic-master.json (enforced by tests/unit/ksic-aliases.test.ts). Each entry carries a 'basis' naming the official KSIC name it maps to. Terms are matched whitespace- and case-insensitively.

aliases.basis: 311 선박 및 보트 건조업; 31111 강선 건조업

29111 내연기관 제조업; 2911 내연기관 및 터빈 제조업 (선박용 대형 디젤엔진은 내연기관으로 분류)
